title: WhyNoIPv6 — Public Engagement
description: What visitors do with the on-demand /check endpoint: volume, outcomes, popular hosts, and requester concentration. Mostly dormant until the site is public.

panels.title: Checks (30d)
panels.description: On-demand live checks requested in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS checks FROM check_job WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(DISTINCT host) AS hosts FROM check_job WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Failure rate (30d)
panels.description: Share of completed check jobs that failed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('done', 'failed')), 0) AS ratio FROM check_job WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: p95 completion (7d)
panels.description: 95th-percentile wall time from request to result for completed checks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - created_at)) AS p95 FROM check_job WHERE status = 'done' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Checks per day by outcome
panels.description: Request volume and outcomes over time — the engagement curve to watch after launch.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '1d') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'done') AS done, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending', 'processing')) AS in_flight FROM check_job WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most-checked hosts (30d)
panels.description: What people actually care about — repeat subjects are outreach targets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT host, count(*) AS checks FROM check_job WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top requesters (30d)
panels.description: Requester-IP concentration — informs the rate-limit tuning. One IP dominating the table is a bot.

targets.rawSql: SELECT requester_ip::text AS requester, count(*) AS checks FROM check_job WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20
